command:
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
python -X utf8 -c "import ctypes; from ctypes import wintypes as w; u=ctypes.WinDLL('user32',use_last_error=True); H=type('H',(ctypes.Structure,),{'_fields_':[('cbSize',w.UINT),('dwFlags',w.DWORD),('lpszDefaultScheme',w.LPWSTR)]}); x=H(); x.cbSize=ctypes.sizeof(x); ok=u.SystemParametersInfoW(0x0042,x.cbSize,ctypes.byref(x),0); print('HC_QUERY_OK='+str(bool(ok))); print('HC_FLAGS='+hex(x.dwFlags)); print('HC_ON='+str(bool(x.dwFlags&1))); print('HC_HOTKEYACTIVE='+str(bool(x.dwFlags&4))); print('HC_HOTKEYAVAILABLE='+str(bool(x.dwFlags&64))); print('HC_SCHEME='+repr(x.lpszDefaultScheme))"
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "High Contrast flag query failed" }
Write-Host "HIGH_CONTRAST_FLAG_PROBE_PASS"
